xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Note 1: Pursuant to Section 2(pp) of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited ( "MMFSL") and its subsidiaries forms part of the Promoter Group. However, on the account of section 19 of the Companies Act, 2013 which prohibits subsidiaries from holding shares in its holding company they are excluded from the list of Promoter Group for the purpose of disclosure in shareholding patter. Note 2: Non Promoter- Non Public category - Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd. Employees Stock Option Trust ( Trust) - pursuant to Regulation 3(5) of SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, the trustees of a trust, which is governed under these regulations, shall not vote in respect of the shares held by such trust, so as to avoid any misuse arising out of exercising such voting rights. Note 3: The Company's currently active ESOP schemes ( ESOP 2010 and RSU Plan 2023) are administered through Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd. Employees Stock Option Trust (Trust) via Trust Route, wherein shares are issued to Trust via primary issuance by the Company. On exercise of vested options, the Trust transfers the shares to the eligible employees. The total number of outstanding options granted as on 30th June 2026 are 16,03,798 . and Trust holds 3,87,460 equity shares in the Company . The trust shall first utilise its existing shareholding for transfer of shares to employees and hence the dilution will be only to the extent of 12,16,338 ( i.e. 16,03,798 less 3,87,460 = 12,16,338) equity shares. From the outstanding options, 2,16,514 options are outstanding against director, 59,770 options are outstanding against KMPs, and the 13,27,514 remaining options are outstanding against resident individuals and others category. Note No.4: Promoter Group list includes Sampo Rosenlew Oy, Finland , Mahindra Ideal Lanka (Private Limited) , MLL Global Logistics Limited, Mahindra Aerospace Australia Pty. Limited and Blue Planet Integrated Waste Solutions Limited who have ceased to be part of the Promoter Group of Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited. These entities are no longer part of the Promoter Group under Regulation 2(1)(pp)(iii) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
